comments.body: **merge-train (2026-11-17): on the train as is.** Validated at `22b709fbf`. Ruling recorded on #4514: the criterion covers the hint line only, so this closes the issue. Notes, not blocking: the spec pins the floor classes rather than a measured height (hiding the hint or enlarging its text leaves it green), and the fixed floor is exceeded by long agent names at 390px and by the server-supplied message at 320px — outside the issue's two widths, but the same class of shift.
